description: A full-featured WPF code editor UserControl for .NET 8. Syntax highlighting for 57+ languages via .whfmt syntaxDefinition (consumed from whfmt.FileFormatCatalog), Roslyn-powered IntelliSense + analyzers + refactorings, code folding, multi-caret editing, dynamic snippets with variable expansion, LSP semantic token colorization, Ctrl+Click navigation, inline hints / reference counts, debug data-tips, search and replace, split view, line numbers, minimap, and more. Zero external dependencies (no AvalonEdit / ICSharpCode).
releaseNotes: 0.10.1.0 — SRP decomposition of CodeEditor internals into 6 focused partial files (rendering, folding, diagnostics, completion, LSP, commands) — no public API changes; ClearType blur fix: single unified orderedTokens pass eliminates dual-render gap causing sub-pixel misalignment on embedded language zone boundaries. 0.10.0.0 — Embedded language injection: HTML script/style blocks, PHP-in-HTML, Markdown fenced blocks via whfmt.FileFormatCatalog 1.5.0 embeddedLanguages[]. 0.9.9.0 — Inline Code Actions (Ctrl+.), Refactor menu, Duplication tab, Dynamic Snippets, Debugger Data Tips; +10 localizations (28 total). 0.9.8.0 — LSP semantic tokens; zoom snap-to-pixel; IReferenceCountProvider; Ctrl+Click links.
title: WpfCodeEditor - WPF Code Editor UserControl
